data.name: AC Bonus
data.description: When unarmored and unencumbered, you add +%1 to your AC and your CMD. These bonuses apply even against touch attacks or when you are flat-footed. You lose these bonuses when you are immobilized or helpless, when you wear any armor, when you carry a shield, or when you carry a medium or heavy load.|MonkACBonus
